snippet.title: [Reveal Trailer] Pipeworks Puzzle
snippet.description:
Pipeworks puzzle adds a new twist to the classic sliding-tile puzzle! Connect pipes as you move them in a grid-based arena to match the blueprint. You can only move the pieces into empty tiles, so plan your next move carefully.

Available on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3671420

Features:

Cute visuals and relaxing audio
A large number of levels with four difficulty levels
Additional challenge to complete the levels with the least amount moves
Brain teaser with the option to choose the level difficulty based on your mood
Easy and intuitive control, using mouse only
Best boss you'll ever have, created by the amazing artist @PokuriMio
